data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company led by founder Ofer Ben-Zur. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity) alongside a broader reference universe that includes 8 private robotics and manufacturing peers and 1 public comparable.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. The three core comparables are valued at $2.0B, $1.8B, and $1.6B respectively, yielding a median of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. This methodology carries particular weight given the difficulty of obtaining financial multiples or revenue-adjusted metrics for early-stage robotics companies; stage and sector alignment provide the most reliable basis for relative valuation in this cohort.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.5B to $2.0B, with a median indication of $1.8B. The primary uncertainty stems from limited methodological triangulation—only peer-median valuation is applicable given data availability constraints. Additional leverage points such as revenue multiples, customer concentration, or technical differentiation metrics would strengthen conviction. The range reflects the observed spread in the three-company peer sample, but wider cross-validation would be needed to assess whether Tritone commands a premium or discount relative to this center.
